pages.title: The Infuser
pages.text: An altar that remembers its patterns. It performs any $(l)Infusion$() on its own: no candles, no circle, no waiting at its side.$(br2)Give it the offering (right-click, or a hopper from above or the side) and feed it mana from a $(l)Mana Battery$(). It takes the same mana the ritual would, and ten seconds of work.

pages.title: Using It
pages.text: $(li)Right-click with an empty hand to take the finished item, or pull it out with a hopper $(l)underneath$().$(li)It is $(l)attuned$() to whoever placed it, and will only perform infusions that person could. Sneak-right-click to attune it to yourself.$(li)Fusions need two hands, so they stay at the altar.$(li)Breaking it drops everything inside.

pages.title: A Note
pages.text: The Infuser can make what you already know how to make. It cannot teach you anything.$(br2)Your $(l)first$() artifact must still be made at the altar, by your own hand, to reach $(l)Mastery$().
